title: Easy Spring Canadian Basil Stew
description: A quick and delicious Canadian dish featuring basil and plant-based ingredients, perfect for a spring evening. This stew is cooked to perfection in a claypot and features spherified basil for a unique twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the claypot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth, canned diced tomatoes, and fresh basil to the claypot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix the sodium alginate with the water to create a spherification bath.
Using a syringe or spoon, drop small amounts of the basil mixture into the spherification bath.
Let the basil spheres sit in the bath for about 5 minutes to set.
Remove the basil spheres from the bath and add them to the stew.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
